_source: Read from Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.0 sts2.dll (assembly IL, not run) by scripts/sts2-pck/extract-card-data.mjs. Per card (keyed by its localization id): energy cost (-1 = no cost orb), costX, star cost, type, rarity, target, keywords, every dynamic var's base value and first-upgrade delta (upgraded = OnUpgrade touches it), upgrade cost/keyword changes, and the pool's energy icon, cost outline colour and frame material. Regenerate after a game patch.
